trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no separate task: work the roadmap in order, clear the one missable trophy early, and the platinum pops on your final trophy.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Clear the Chapter 1 missable first (Positive Mental Attitude).
Play the story in order, stages 1-3 of the roadmap.
Mop up activities and collectibles in stages 4-5.
The platinum unlocks automatically with your 54th trophy.

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission: Lucia and Jason's first job together on the water. It teaches the basics — driving, shooting, and the duo dynamic — and ends with your first taste of Leonida's heat.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play through the opening.
Follow the on-screen prompts through the fishing setup.
Finish the mission's final sequence to trigger the trophy.

trophies.guide: Chapter 1 closes once its story missions are done. Expect a few hours of story, side introductions, and your first real choices about who Lucia and Jason trust.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play every Chapter 1 story mission.
The chapter ends after its final mission's cutscene.
Before the chapter ends, finish the missable meditation trophy — see Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.guide: Chapter 2 pushes the duo deeper into Leonida's drug trade. New contacts, bigger jobs, and the first missions where a wrong call costs you.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Complete every Chapter 2 story mission in order.
The trophy pops at the chapter's closing cutscene.

trophies.guide: Chapter 3 brings the story home to Vice City proper — neon, Ocean Drive, and the jobs that make the duo's name. Story missions only; side content can wait.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through all Chapter 3 story missions.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter finale.

trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the climb: the duo at their most ambitious, taking on the jobs that put them on top of Leonida's underworld. Finish its missions to close the chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Complete every Chapter 4 story mission.
The trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.guide: The final mission is the story's last word — everything Lucia and Jason built comes due. Finish it and the gold is yours.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Reach the final story mission after Chapter 4.
Complete it; the gold unlocks on the results screen.

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is an early story mission and a character beat: a job that runs on trust between the duo. Play it as part of Chapter 1's story line.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run unlocks.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is one of the story's big scores — planning, execution, and a getaway. It unlocks in the mid-story mission chain.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Progress the story until The Cartel Heist appears.
Complete the heist.

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission about family — the kind of job that shows what Lucia and Jason are really fighting for.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission with a headline act — loud, public, and messy. It sits in the middle of the story's second act.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Progress the story to Headliners.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown takes the duo into Vice City International Airport for a takedown job. Expect tight spaces and heavy resistance.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a late-story operation — the biggest set piece before the finale. Bring your best weapons and armour.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Progress the story to Operation Savage Glory.
Complete the operation.

trophies.guide: 100% completion means everything: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles, and the miscellaneous checklist. The in-game stats page tracks your percentage — use it as your map.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story and all stranger strands.
Clear every activity, race, and challenge type at least once.
Collect every collectible set and explore all 52 areas.
Check the stats page; at 100% the gold pops.

trophies.guide: 250 stunts is a grind best done in small doses: jumps, near misses, and airtime all count. A fast bike on Vice City's jumps and ramps racks them up fastest.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Pick a fast bike and a ramp-heavy route.
Chain jumps, wheelies, and near misses.
The counter ticks in the stats page; 250 earns the silver.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types in Leonida — try each one once. Races, fishing, shooting range, bowling, arcade, drone races, and the rest. One taste of each is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the activities list and note the 9 types.
Try each type once.
The trophy pops after the ninth type.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: All 42 Shooting Range challenges at gold medal standard. This is the hardest pure-skill grind in the list: learn each weapon's recoil, take your time, and replay challenges until every one is gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and try every challenge.
Learn the scoring: accuracy and speed both matter.
Replay each challenge until all 42 show gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course; learn the gates, cut corners where the course allows, and keep the drone low.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win one race at each location.
The trophy pops after the 14th win.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — street races, off-road, and water. Variety matters: the same race twice counts once.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races around the map.
Win 20 distinct races.
Track progress in the stats page.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is a patience game: watch the line tension, reel in bursts, and don't let the fish snap the line.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Win the challenge against Cal.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Arcades are scattered around Vice City — pick any cabinet, play to the end, and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play and complete one full game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's final mission closes his story arc. His missions unlock through the story — play them as they come and finish the last one.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Play Andy's mission strand as it unlocks.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's final mission ends his arc on the water. His missions appear through the mid-story; finish the last one.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Play Kenton's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's final mission closes the rider's arc. His strand runs through the story's middle chapters.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Play Billy's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger mission strands are scattered across Leonida — odd jobs for odd people. Each strand is several missions; the map markers point the way.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Find stranger markers across the state.
Complete all 8 strands to their final missions.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's final mission closes his supply-chain arc. His jobs unlock in the story's second half.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Play Randy's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's final mission ends his arc. His strand runs through the mid-to-late story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Play Tyrone's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable trophy — the only confirmed one. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, and the Chapter 1 balcony meditation can only be done in Chapter 1. COUNT UNCONFIRMED: the 18-spot total comes from community lists and is not yet verified against the final game. Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 so you can return if you miss it.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: At the start of Chapter 1, make a MANUAL save.
Meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot before the chapter ends.
Find and meditate at the other 17 spots across Leonida.
If the balcony spot is missed, reload your manual Chapter 1 save.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Unique animals roam specific wild areas — track the one Bret wants, hunt it cleanly, and bring proof back.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Talk to Bret to learn which animal he wants.
Track it in the wilds of Leonida.
Hunt it and return to Bret.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, alleys, and landmarks. COUNT UNCONFIRMED: the 3-set total comes from community lists and is not yet verified. A full set means every card in it.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards as you explore.
Complete any 3 full sets.
The trophy pops on the third completed set.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — the game's photo-spot collectible. Every marked viewpoint counts once. COUNT UNCONFIRMED: the 100-location total comes from community lists and is not yet verified. Work through the map region by region so none are missed.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open a WAiNK spot and take the shot.
Repeat at 100 different locations.
Region-by-region sweeping avoids backtracking.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's mini-objectives — stunts, kills, driving feats. They accumulate naturally, but the last few need deliberate chasing.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Play normally; challenges tick as you go.
Check the challenges list for what remains.
Target the final few deliberately.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the cops to 4 stars together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Raise your wanted level to 4 stars with your partner beside you.
Break line of sight and hide.
Escape clean and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route past three shops, hit them fast, and keep the cops off you between each one.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Pick three shops close together.
Rob them in sequence with your partner.
Keep your wanted level through all three.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles register when you drive them — steal, borrow, or buy, then take each for a spin. Variety is the whole game here.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive any vehicle you have not driven before.
Each new model registers once.
100 distinct vehicles earns the trophy.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first — a crowded room, then trigger Combat Focus and chain the five takedowns before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a spot with 5 or more enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to the airport, grab a plane, and leave on your own schedule — the tower will not approve.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Enter VCIA and reach a runway plane.
Take off without clearance.

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — deal with the tanks. Rhinos appear at high wanted levels and military spots; take one on with explosives and cover.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Draw a Rhino out at a high wanted level.
Destroy or hijack it.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses, no cameras catching you. Night helps; so does a silenced approach.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Scout the jewelry store's cameras and staff.
Enter unseen and take the goods.
Leave without raising the alarm.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Each vault is a full job: get in, crack it, get out before the response arrives. Five clean getaways earn the silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find the five bank vault locations.
Rob each vault and escape.
Five escapes earns the trophy.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Trucks run set routes — intercept one, crack it open, and lose the heat before it builds.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it and rob it.
Escape clean.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every named area on the map. COUNT UNCONFIRMED: the 52-area total comes from community lists and is not yet verified. Drive or walk into each area until the map fills in.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Open the map and note unexplored areas.
Visit each one.
The trophy pops when the last area registers.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own rackets — find one operation per gang and hit it.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Learn which gang runs which operation.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the beachfront bar, order the cocktail, and take in the view — the simplest trophy in the list.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail at the beachfront bar.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Pick a showroom, get in a car, and drive straight through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom.
Get in a car and smash out through the front.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game of bowling — follow-through and all.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — a story beat about the duo's rising profile. It unlocks through the story; no grinding needed.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play the story until the moment arrives.
Complete the story beat.

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The game tracks your decisions — 500 choices is the count PlayStation tracks. Play naturally and choose often; dialogue choices and side decisions all count.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make choices whenever the game offers them.
The counter builds across the whole playthrough.
At 500 choices the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the retry — the trophy is for the comeback, not the first attempt.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail a mission or challenge.
Retry and succeed on the second attempt.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Leonida hides strange sights — a UFO, a cryptid, something that should not be there. Find one and witness it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners at night.
Witness a strange event.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Line up a crowd, swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, and knock them down like pins.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Find a group on foot.
Drive past swinging a melee weapon.
Knock them down in one pass.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists; your contacts wash them for a cut. Keep laundering until the total hits $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Earn Marked Bills from heists.
Launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, cars, food — every dollar counts. Big purchases get you there fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend money in any shops.
The counter tracks total spend.
$100,000 spent earns the trophy.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garages to buy across Leonida — each one stores your vehicles and counts toward the trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Find the 8 garage properties for sale.
Buy all 8.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app wants your rides on its books — register any 10 vehicles you own or drive.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 vehicles.
